fee_notes: Standard initial franchise fee is $40,000. A 50% discount ($20,000) is available to franchisees signing an additional franchise agreement. A 50% discount ($20,000) is also available to U.S. military veterans through the VetFran program. Qualified franchisees may use only one discount program. All fees are due upon signing and are non-refundable. During the last fiscal year, initial franchise fees collected were uniform.
raw_excerpt: The initial franchise fee is $40,000. Franchisees that sign an additional franchise agreement, regardless of when they sign, will receive 50% off the current franchise fee (presently discounted to $20,000). We also participate in the VetFran program and offer a 50% discount on the initial franchise fee to U.S. military veterans (presently discounted to $20,000). Veterans will also receive 50% off the current initial franchise fee for additional franchise agreements (presently discounted to $20,000). Qualified franchisees can take advantage of one discount program, but not both.
